edition.subtitle: What Immunology Can Teach Us About Self-Perception

first_sentence.value: Last Thursday, one of those gray fall days when the starlings gather up and string between the elms around here, my first wife, my children's mother-dead ten years-walked into a pastry shop where I was buttering a croissant.
